states.adopted: An authored profile row exists and binds this mode. Equals MOVE-C2-R01's 'S/N' cell: production qualification is still NOT ready. Never an admission grant. admission_qualified is false for every such row in this file.
states.explicitly_disabled: An identified AUTHORED prohibition applies to this profile/action/state, with its reason and the conditions that can change it preserved. Equals MOVE-C2-R01's DISABLED.
states.unresolved_q2: The required authored profile is missing or incomplete, or required implementation/qualification is missing. Equals MOVE-C2-R01's AUTHORED_PROFILE_NOT_READY and the code's UNPROFILED / MODE_NOT_PROFILED. This is NOT a prohibition and NOT a claim that a finished profile exists.

validator_rules: rows MUST contain exactly 16 species keys; each MUST contain exactly the 3 life_stages; each MUST contain exactly the 6 modes. 288 leaf entries, no more and no fewer.
Every leaf value MUST resolve to a key of row_classes.
row_classes[*].state MUST be one of the three declared states.
No row_class may set admission_qualified true while any of its blocking_q2_slots is unfilled.
Every q2_slot MUST have value null in this file. A non-null value is a lane violation.

blocking_contract MUST reference a blocking_contracts key whose kind is 'admission'. A row whose blocking_contract has kind 'presentation' is a validation FAILURE: MOVE-DEP-R03 forbids a presentation gap gating admission.
presentation_gaps entries MUST NOT appear in any row's blocking_contract or evidence_absent.
totals MUST equal the recomputed counts over rows.
mode_scope_note: system_scope is a settlement-scope statement, never a per-species capability grant. SET-MOVE-001 §1 excludes 'a blanket innate ability table inferred from species or slide lists'; MOVE-C2-R01: 'No table entry grants an innate ability.' There is no FLIGHT mode; sparrow and kestrel stay grounded under MOVE-DEP-R03, which is a scope exclusion and not a prohibition on any of the six modes.
species_id_source: godot/data/catalog_ids.json domains.SpeciesDefinition (compiled ascending ASCII). Size classes from residents.gd SPECIES_SMALL_KEYS / SPECIES_MEDIUM_KEYS / SPECIES_LARGE_KEYS. Neither was hand-numbered.

inherited_settled_inputs.note: Cycle 2: these are inherited inputs, not questions reopened by this cycle. They must not be re-derived, re-proposed or refined by this lane.
inherited_settled_inputs.DEC-039_bounds: Approval of anatomical scale only. Landmark ratios remain PROPOSED_FOR_REVIEW. These heights do NOT set navigation clearance, service reach, step height or movement capability, and no clearance in this package is derived from one.
inherited_settled_inputs.DEC-040: Spoil is a real haulable reusable material with its own catalog identity and declared mass. Hazards are warned, preventable, with rescue through existing injury/care. Four underground levels at 4 m spacing remains a CANDIDATE.
inherited_settled_inputs.ECON: ECON-001 cut quantum is an axis-aligned 1024u cube (1 m3) on the 1024u lattice; MOVE-C2-R01 states it is NOT a navigation voxel or body envelope. ECON-002..006 item identity, operations, lifecycle, hauling, cancellation/refund and conservation are authored.
inherited_settled_inputs.HAZ: HAZ-001 hazard policy, dangerous-action classification and entry thresholds; HAZ-002 air_standard_v1 (1200 capacity, 1/submerged tick, 4/breathable tick, +300 contingency, advisory <=450, 125 health/game-hour airless drain, admission available_air >= T+300, planned underwater queue wait 0); HAZ-003 exhaustion/fall/recovery including protected-climb build cost and the unprotected-climb consequence formulas; HAZ-004 rescue/treatment; HAZ-005 interruption matrix; HAZ-006 fixtures. All assign no species capability.
inherited_settled_inputs.adopted_scope: Persistent constructed tunnels, inhabited underground space, interoperable placed-burrow / planned-tunnel / free multi-level excavation, surface swimming, diving, connected climbing and canopy access all remain first-release requirements under SET-MOVE-001 §1 and DEC-029/031/035.
inherited_settled_inputs.engine_conventions: 30 Hz; speeds 0/1/2/4; int32 positions in 1/1024 m; -Z forward, +Y up; 256 living / 512 resident slots; clearance class domain 1..512 over 512u north-west anchored squares with predicate _clearance[cell] >= class; root offset (+256,+256); ground caps 3277/4096/3072 u/s and 12000/16000/24000 g; LifeStage ADULT 0 / CHILD 1 / ELDER 2 with COUNT 3 a bound never stored.

authored_prohibitions.scope: work and job class, NOT a traversal mode row
authored_prohibitions.subject: CHILD hazardous work and excavation
authored_prohibitions.conditions_that_can_change_it: None stated. PC-04 owns CHILD and ELDER activation.
authored_prohibitions.note: Deliberately NOT expressed as a species x mode row. Whether it extends to CHILD non-work travel in dangerous modes is Q2-32.

authored_prohibitions.scope: action- and state-conditioned, applicable to every species; never species-wide
authored_prohibitions.subject: MOVE-C2-R01's explicit disabled actions and admission refusals: incomplete/unsupported/water-intersecting excavation; dangerous entry without consent or at health<70, hunger<=3500, rest<4000, or active untreated injury; dive without protected breathable endpoint, complete finite round trip, or available_air>=T+300; surface swim without declared float/return and incapacity/submergence recovery; climb without protected support/rescue attachment or without a declared fall landing/trajectory; removal of occupied passage, only safe exit, protected air landing/descent or rescue support; free flight, branch-gap jumps, underwater attacks, moving vessels, unsupported collapse/flood shortcuts.

species_wide_prohibition_note: MOVE-C2-R01: 'Species-wide DISABLED rows for the four requested modes: zero established by current policy.' A missing profile is never recorded here. Missing profile != authored incompatibility.

RC_ADULT_GROUND_STARTER.note: Mode binding is authored; production qualification is not. profile_clearance_class_into() refuses PROFILE_CLEARANCE_UNSPECIFIED for this profile id.

RC_ADULT_FORD_STARTER.note: Additionally: FORD_WALK has a distinct mode id and bit but no distinct cell predicate or cost in movement.gd. _cursor_mode is written at _attach_route() and read only by admitted_mode_of().

RC_ADULT_GROUND_UNPROFILED.note: No starter profile row exists for this species. movement.gd refuses PROFILE_SPECIES_MISMATCH rather than borrowing a size neighbour. This is not a prohibition.

RC_ADULT_SWIM.refuses_today: MODE_NOT_PROFILED; and DOMAIN_NOT_CONTRACTED for any non-ground domain
RC_ADULT_SWIM.note: Adopted as required settlement capability under SET-MOVE-001 §1. Not profiled, not prohibited.

RC_ADULT_DIVE.refuses_today: MODE_NOT_PROFILED; and movement.gd holds no air state at all (searched for air / available_air / air_remaining / AIR: zero matches)
RC_ADULT_DIVE.note: air_standard_v1 is authored and assigns no species capability. Q2-19 is which profiles bind it.

RC_ADULT_CLIMB.note: Protected-climb build cost and unprotected-climb consequence formulas are settled under HAZ-003. The arcs, landings and drops they price do not exist.

RC_ADULT_TUNNEL.note: Walking a completed supported tunnel is ordinary access and is independent of excavation capability. ECON-001's 1024u priced cube is not a navigation voxel or body envelope.

RC_CHILD_NONHAZ.refuses_today: LIFE_STAGE_NOT_PROFILED (movement.gd PROFILE_LIFE_STAGE is four entries, all ADULT)
RC_CHILD_NONHAZ.note: Release immobility for CHILD is NOT adopted. No adult coefficient is substituted. The missing rig variant (PG-RIG-STAGE-VARIANT) is a presentation gap and is deliberately not listed as a blocker.

RC_CHILD_HAZ.note: HAZ-001 classifies DIVE, SWIM_SURFACE and unprotected CLIMB as dangerous, and forbids CHILD hazardous WORK and excavation (PROHIB-CHILD-HAZARDOUS-WORK). Whether that extends to CHILD non-work travel in these modes is Q2-32 and is NOT decided here. Until it is ruled, the state stays unresolved_q2 rather than being upgraded to explicitly_disabled by inference.

RC_ELDER_NONHAZ.note: DEC-032 requires active elder roles. MOVE-C2-R01 forbids inferring an elder penalty. No elder coefficient is proposed.

totals.cross_check: adult_connected_rows_not_ready = 64 matches MOVE-C2-R01 'all 64 adult species/mode combinations'. adult_ground_ford_adopted = 8 matches the ruling's four S/N species across two modes.

explicitly_not_proposed: Any body, gear, cargo or swept dimension in any unit.
Any clearance class for any profile.
Any mode speed, entry/exit/turn duration or edge cost.
Any air budget, depth, elevation, level count or level spacing.
Any route recentring, alternative root offset, or change to the (+256,+256) production placement.
Any species-wide prohibition, and any inference of incompatibility from a missing profile.
Any CHILD or ELDER coefficient, and any adult fallback for a non-adult stage.
Any save schema version, packed column, arena capacity or byte-ledger change.
Any change to DEC-039 heights, DEC-040 direction, or the ECON/HAZ parameter set.
